context: Tests whether the draft skill produces both a plan file and a beads task graph with proper structure, agent context blocks in issue descriptions, and correct phase ordering.

checklist.name: Plan file created
checklist.description: A plan file matching docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-*-plan.md is created

checklist.name: Beads epic created
checklist.description: A beads epic is created for the feature via the beads:epic skill

checklist.name: Issues with deps
checklist.description: Per-agent-step beads issues are created with dependency wiring via beads:dep

checklist.name: Agent context blocks
checklist.description: Issue descriptions contain Agent Context information including file paths, test specs, commands, and gates

checklist.name: Phase ordering
checklist.description: Implementation phases follow Database → Core → Repository → Features → Routes ordering
